verdict.rationale: Temporal documents Queries, Signals and Updates. Workflows act as stateful services with message handlers, and a client can query a running Workflow Execution. A frontend could therefore poll a query handler for step-level progress, but the evidence describes no native push or streaming channel to a frontend, and nothing on streaming model tokens out of Activities. missing for 10: native streaming/push of workflow progress to clients, token-level streaming from LLM Activities, frontend integration docs or examples, hands-on corroboration.
